contentPattern.structure: title + arrow link (whole card clickable); first card dark charcoal, rest light

suitableFor: 'ways to open / ways to apply' CTA card rows with a bold title and a single link per card
channel-selection cards (e.g. 'Use the Money app', 'Ask us to call you back') where the whole card is clickable
short action cards where the first card is emphasised with a dark/charcoal background
notSuitableFor: cards with descriptive body text and icons (use cards-info or cards-cover)
